summary_text: Phase two diligence session for Project Falcon with Acme Capital. Northwind Analytics generated $4.2M EBITDA on eighteen million total revenue in FY23. Sarah Chen approved $50,000 for vendor expenditures with CloudScale Systems. Deal structured as an asset purchase agreement with a 10% indemnity holdback based on a forty-five million valuation. Northwind plans to expand into Australia with 5 new regional offices in Q4. Special advisor Zephyrine Quillfeather confirmed the audit schedule and compliance checklist.
action_items: David Vance sends customer concentration data by Friday.
Legal counsel uploads IP assignment certificates by Monday.
Acme Capital circulates revised purchase agreement by Wednesday.
key_decisions: Credit line of $400,000 to be paid off at closing.
